findings.text: blocking: The read returns only decisions, with no pending or taken-and-reversible lists; validate_decision also drops any pending-run or reversible-state input and rejects a taken choice, so a question that must wait for a run is immediately mixed with ready questions and can never transition as required by live plan s1.

blocking: The whitelist drops a no-queue risk, lead-required action and recommendation provenance, and the read never establishes whether a live session owns the plan; _plan_decisions also discards the existing recommended_by field, so the lead cannot distinguish an owner recommendation from a reviewer recommendation or see what an otherwise empty hold releases.

blocking: The question and context expectations at lines 114-115 come from record_decision's returned record rather than the input fixture; replacing either field with a constant in validate_decision changes both persisted content and expected content together and both assertions stay green, leaving the promised content-preservation regression unguarded.

blocking: _options duplicates the value/label normalization owned by reckon/_store.py:_decision_options_as_choices:4122 instead of wrapping or extending it; two normalization mechanisms can drift, so the strict count/recommendation/label checks should be layered on the existing owner.
